scientific_limitations: Passive planar free motion, independent Poisson orientation resets to one angle, no positional jumps, isotropic translational mobility and nonzero angular cross mobility. The sharp optimizer concerns the absolute long-time covariance-rate difference, not all sorting metrics or non-Poisson protocols.
title: A universal optimal reset rate for diffusion anisotropy in a rotationally coupled colloid
